scoring_justification: Full recompute of QM/MM DFT calculations is infeasible in the verifier sandbox; scoring the agent's reported values against paper-reported gold with tolerances is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for formation energies, crossing point, ionisation energies, and PL transitions derived from the paper's reported results
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper 'Determination of the nitrogen vacancy as a shallow compensating center in GaN doped with divalent metals', DOI 10.48550/arXiv.1412.1694, text and Table I.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Transcribed exactly from the paper: Mg_Ga formation energy 0.783 eV (N-rich), V_N crossing 1.835 eV, V_N vertical IE 44 meV, Mg PL transitions 3.272/3.228/3.471/3.196 eV.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly quoted from the paper's quantitative results used to support the main claims, not invented.

schema.description: A single line containing the formation energy in eV, formatted as '<value> eV'.

outputs.description: Formation energy of neutral Mg_Ga (axial hole configuration) under N-rich conditions, compared against a hidden reference value within tolerance.

schema.description: A single line containing the Fermi energy crossing point in eV above VBM, formatted as '<value> eV'.

outputs.description: Fermi energy at which V_N^+ and V_N^3+ formation energies cross, compared against a hidden reference value within tolerance.

schema.description: A single line containing the vertical ionisation energy in meV, formatted as '<value> meV'.

outputs.description: Vertical ionisation energy of V_N^0 relative to CBM, compared against a hidden reference value within tolerance.
CSV containing vertical ionisation energies for at least the two key PL transitions (basal-plane/singlet and axial/singlet). Each row is compared against a hidden reference value within tolerance.

output_contract.notes: All scored outputs are evaluated by result-level compare (T0) against paper-reported values with tolerances: formation energies ±0.1 eV, ionisation energies ±0.05 eV. The reward is monotonic in closeness; meeting or exceeding precision earns full credit.

steps.description: Formation energy of Mg_Ga^0 (axial hole) under N-rich conditions
Fermi energy crossing point of V_N^+ and V_N^3+ formation energies
Shallow donor vertical ionisation energy of V_N^0 relative to CBM
